name: io.github.atushi1841/japan-geospatial-open-data-mcp
description: MCP server for Japan's national geospatial open data: GSI geocoding & XYZ tiles (keyless), e-Stat statistics (optional ESTAT_APP_ID), MLIT school district GIS (keyless), MLIT Real Estate Information Library XKT004 (optional REINFOLIB_API_KEY). Covers real-estate school-zone analysis, education infrastructure, disaster planning, urban design.
